$comment: Where Tracy Business (EmDash template, packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-business at 1.5.1) keeps each topic, read off its own source, seed and the EmDash core it runs; every entry carries its proof and test/content-where.test.mjs re-reads them. The site runs EmDash 1.1.0 and this repo vendors core 1.1.0 (1.0.1 from 29/09/2026; 1.4.5 and 1.4.6 ran 0.38.0): the core routes (robots.txt, sitemap.xml, SEO tags) are read off the vendored core. Left out, not provable here: form fields, labels and recipients (the Forms plugin publishes no tool), the canonical origin (an environment variable).

pages.what: A new page: an entry in the 'pages' collection (served at /<slug>). Its content is a Markdown string (EmDash converts it; # headings, paragraphs); status published puts it live. Then its menu link.

arguments.name: primary
arguments.items: <every item menu_get answered, plus {label:<title>, type:"custom", customUrl:"/<slug>"} where it should sit>

pages.languages: One entry per language (locale; another language's page is a translationOf entry) and its menu row carries the /<language> prefix.

proof.has: view = { component: Page, props: { slug: a } }
pass a Markdown string — converted to Portable Text automatically; prefer
items are in the shape menu_set_items takes

seo.what: Page title: the part of <title> before ' — ' (the home tab of a site with its own name shows the name alone), and og:title. 'a|b' means field a when it is set, else b.
seo.languages: One entry row per language: add locale for another language.

proof.has: const fullTitle = pageTitleOf({ title, siteTitle, home: currentPath === '/' })

seo.what: Site name: after ' — ' in every <title>, og:site_name and the JSON-LD WebSite name.
seo.languages: One value for every language: settings have no locale.

seo.what: Meta description and og:description: the page's own intro field, which the page also shows as its lede. 'a|b' means a when set, else b.
seo.languages: One entry row per language: add locale for another language.

seo.what: Entry SEO panel: only noIndex (out of /sitemap.xml) and image show. seo.title and seo.description are refused: the template's head wins; write the title field and the intro instead.
seo.languages: One entry row per language: add locale for another language.

proof.has: Fields the template leaves unset still fall

seo.what: og:image: the SEO panel's image, else a post's or project's picture, else seo.defaultOgImage; a hero (home, about, careers, projects list) only when that is unset (before 1.7.5: always).
seo.languages: One entry row per language; seo.defaultOgImage is one for every language.

proof.has: const ogImage = page.seo?.ogImage || page.image || defaultOgImage || null;

seo.what: JSON-LD: EmDash core prints a WebSite object named after the site on every page and a BlogPosting on news posts; the template adds none of its own.
seo.languages: The site name is one for every language; a post is one row per language.

seo.what: hreflang and x-default: one link per language whose translation of the page is published; nothing is stored for it.

where.derived: the published translations of the page's entry

seo.languages: Each language is its own entry row; publishing it adds that language's link, while that language's site entry is published too.

seo.what: Search-engine verification tags (google-site-verification, Bing): settings seo, which settings_update replaces whole.

arguments.seo: <the seo object settings_get answers, googleVerification set>

design.what: Colours, radius and container width: each token reads a design-system role (--ds-*) with its own value as fallback; dark under html[data-theme="dark"]. Shows after a rebuild.

proof.has: outside the folder file tools reach

design.what: Fonts (Archivo, Newsreader): downloaded from Google Fonts at build time, Vietnamese subset included, and mapped to --font-sans and --font-serif in tokens.css. An edit shows after a rebuild.

call.command: <edit /app/src/fonts.json (and tokens.css if a variable name changes) in the site's container>

design.what: The brand lockup in the header is text, not a picture: fields brand_mark, brand_name and brand_sub of the site entry.
design.languages: One site row per language: add locale for another language.

menus.what: Six menus: primary (header, mobile menu, /sitemap groups), topbar, resources_kit (Resources panel), footer_services, footer_company, footer_legal. menu_set_items replaces the whole list.

arguments.name: primary
arguments.items: <every item menu_get answered, with the change>

menus.languages: One menu row per language; another language's links carry its /<language> prefix.

proof.has: items are in the shape menu_set_items takes

forms.what: Contact page form: the page embeds the form named by form_id. The form's fields, labels and recipients live in the Forms plugin, which no tool here reaches.

proof.has: Category and form labels have no door here.

forms.what: Newsletter sign-up on /news, /investors and /kit/newsletter: its form id and words (newsletter_title, _text, _placeholder, _button) are fields of the news page entry.
forms.languages: One news page row per language.

forms.what: Turn the contact form off: set form_id to "" on the contact entry of each language served (the card shows a dash instead). Back on: write back the form_id its receipt shows as before.
forms.languages: One contact entry per language, each with its own form_id: one write per language served.

proof.has:
{c.form_id ? :

—

}
for `content_update` each field asked for, before and after
content_update with the same collection and id, data = each field

analytics.what: A tracking snippet: no setting, field or installed plugin holds one; it goes in the <head> of the layout every page uses. Template source: shows after a rebuild.

call.command: <add the snippet to the <head> of /app/src/layouts/Base.astro in the site's container>

redirects.what: Redirects (301/302 between paths of the site): EmDash's own redirect store, read at each request before any page, so a new one is live at once and needs no rebuild.
redirects.languages: One rule for every language; write the path as visitors type it.

robots.what: robots.txt: EmDash serves settings seo.robotsTxt (a Sitemap line added), else its default. While the site is a draft Tracy answers /robots.txt itself.

arguments.seo: <the seo object settings_get answers, robotsTxt set>

robots.what: /sitemap.xml: EmDash lists published entries of routable collections with the SEO panel (services, projects, posts, pages); an entry with seo.noIndex is left out.
robots meta: every page says 'index, follow' but /search ('noindex, follow') and the 404 page ('noindex, nofollow'), set in the views. Template source: shows after a rebuild.

call.command: <edit the robots value of the view in /app/src/views/ in the site's container>

robots.languages: One value per page for every language.

strings.what: Words every page shares (top bar, header, footer and its column titles, copyright, search, 404, theme switch): fields of the one site entry per language.
strings.languages: One site row per language: add locale for another language, or tracy_site content.replace for the same words everywhere.

proof.has: "description": "Topbar, header, footer, search and 404 copy. One entry per locale."

strings.what: News labels (tags, previous and next, table of contents, related): fields of the news page entry.
strings.languages: One news page row per language.

strings.what: Words the template code says itself: language names in the switcher, the mobile menu button, 'N min read', the date format. Template source: shows after a rebuild.
strings.languages: One object per language in the file.

proof.has: The few words the THEME says itself, per locale.
